name: Steak 'n Shake — former Rolla location
evidenceSummary: Freddy's own dated announcement says it opened at this exact address on December 16, 2025. That specific newer-tenant evidence overrides the stale but functioning Steak 'n Shake branch page and locator entry. Current OSM identity is also Freddy's, despite inherited Steak 'n Shake website, phone and Bitcoin tags.
reason: Remove the former Steak 'n Shake candidate and do not retain Freddy's using inherited Bitcoin tags. No primary evidence of Freddy's Bitcoin acceptance was established.

name: Steak 'n Shake — Davenport
evidenceSummary: Official branch and BTC Map have the same exact street number/street/city/ZIP, official branch URL and phone 563-344-0701. They represent one restaurant despite a coordinate offset of approximately 176.3 metres.
reason: Exact business identifiers resolve duplicate identity. Do not create a second record solely because the official locator pin is over a distance threshold.
coordinateDecision: Preserve existing BTC Map building point while merging official evidence; absolute rooftop accuracy was not independently proven.
geometryEvidence: BTC Map's stored OSM geometry is an address-tagged building polygon. The existing point is its bounding-box centre; official locator point lies outside that polygon.

independentAddressCheck.limitation: Street-range interpolation, not rooftop validation; do not use this point to replace the mapped building.
